## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:把 `sql-driver.ts` 里「跨字段比较」与「相对当前时间比较」(`{ $field }`、`{ $now, addDays }` 过滤条件)的 SQL 编译代码原样搬进新文件 `sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts`;类上的方法全部保留,只把方法体转交过去。
- **为什么改**:#25521 拆分超大文件的第 13 刀;这块在剩余可搬区域里收益最大,`sql-driver.ts` 减少 470 行。
- **风险与回滚**:纯搬移,无行为变化;三个 SQL 驱动的测试两端逐条一致,公开类型声明哈希不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**:`sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts` 的头注释与 host 接口;`sql-driver.ts` 中四个方法的转交桩;`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` 的枚举改为同时读两个文件。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`,预期 115 个测试全部通过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Cut 13 of the `sql-driver.ts` split (#24586 ruling A, recorded in `6270097840`). The claim is `6429655341`. The cut opens with a fresh seam table (below), taken on `origin/main` `77a52cfe8` (after cut 12's merge `8b39b77674`), and takes the area that pays best without breaking a series limit: the **cross-field and now-anchored comparison compile** of the Filter helpers section. It moves unedited into a **new** seam module, `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts`, through a new host `CrossFieldComparisonHost`:

- `applyCrossFieldComparison`, the #5222 column-to-column arm and its #14104 `addDays` offset;
- `applyNowAnchorComparison`, the #25808 `{ $now, addDays }` comparand;
- `nowAnchorBaseExpr` and `crossFieldOffsetExpr`, the two operand builders both arms read.

The change is move-only, and the card stays open for later cuts. There is no `docs/adr/**` edit, no `packages/spec/**` edit, no anchor entry change, no gate edit and no new gate. Branch `claude/project-thread-5r39ss` (the platform assigned it to this card thread, as the claim records). The move is one commit, `b1f89c17c`, on `77a52cfe8`; then `origin/main` was merged once before opening (`e1c1a2b07c`), which brought no `packages/drivers/**` file.

**Net line count (the seat's rule).** `sql-driver.ts` goes from 20,492 lines to 20,022: **-470**.

- **Out:** the four bodies, 328 lines (189 + 112 + 9 + 18). Five module-level declarations that only these bodies read, 172 lines with their docblocks plus 5 separator lines: `CrossFieldOffset` (22), `fieldReferenceOffsetOf` (16), `uncompilableNowAnchorError` (22), `crossFieldComparisonClass` (74) and `uncompilableFieldReferenceError` (38). And the 6-line spec import `crossFieldColumnVerdict, type CrossFieldComparisonClass` with its comment, whose last reader (`crossFieldComparisonClass`) moved; it moved whole into the module.
- **In:** the four stub bodies, 37 lines (each is 4 lines, plus 2 per field read and 1 per method read), and a 4-line import of the module with its comment.
- The new module is 608 lines.

**Serial with the file's in-flight PRs.** I read the full file list of every open PR twice: at start, before cut 12 merged (22 PRs), and again after it, before `pr_create` (19 PRs). No open PR touches `sql-driver.ts`, `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`, `turso-driver.ts`, `sqlite-wasm-driver.ts`, `check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` or the driver-sql anchor entries. #26138 touches `driver-sql/src/builtin-column-collision.ts` only; #26337 adds `driver-sql/src/sql-driver-external-unprovisioned-sort-anchor.test.ts` only.

### Pricing the areas

Eligibility is as cuts 11-12 defined it: an annotated return type or not public; no `getBuilder`, `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(`, private-static, `super`, bare-`this` or `this`-write site; not `insertOnlyUpsertColumns`. 150 members are eligible on this base. Each is priced as its stub minus its body; per section, the sum over eligible bodies with a negative price and no `sql-driver.ts#…` pointer is: Filter helpers -550 (22 bodies), the Rotation sub-banner -195 (7), CRUD -157 (12), every other section -93 or less. Each candidate area is then priced **net of the module-level declarations it shares with members that stay** (they stay in place, exported; ⛔ no second copy of a helper); the declarations only the moved bodies read move with them.

## Why this area

- **It pays the most of any area that moves cleanly.** The four bodies are one mechanism, the column-to-column and now-anchored arms of the filter compile, and only `applyFilterCondition` calls them.
- **What stays, and why.**
  - `applyFilterCondition`, the one caller of both arms, stays with the operator dispatch (ADR-0139 names it by path).
  - `declaredFieldsFor`, `resolveTenantField`, `mapSortField`, `remoteColumn` and `filterColumnExpr` are read by members that stay too. The moved bodies reach them through the host.
- **Shared declarations, exported in place (cut 2/11/12 shape).** `crossFieldComparisonError` and `nowAnchorPositionError` (also thrown by `assertCompilableComparand`, `classifyFilterKey` and `applyFilterCondition`), `NowAnchor` (also read by `nowAnchorOf`), `fieldReferenceOf`, `mysqlDatetimeLiteral` (also read by `storageDatetimeValue`), `withheldFilterError` (the #8220 seam every compile refusal goes through), `JSON_COLUMN_TYPES` and `NUMERIC_SCALAR_TYPES`. Each gains a leading `export` and nothing else, and the module imports them back. The module reads them only inside function bodies, so the import cycle is evaluation-safe. `index.ts` names its exports one by one; the export lists below prove none of the eight leaks.
- **No series limit is touched.** None of the four builds through `getBuilder`, reads a static, has a `this.FIELD.delete/insert/update(` site, uses `super` or a bare `this`, or writes to `this`. All four are protected with annotated returns. `check:tenant-chokepoint`'s D8 predicates, measured with its own `nullArmsOf`: **4 at base and 4 at head**, all in `sql-driver.ts`, 0 in the new module. The two arms name the tenant column only to **refuse** it as an operand (9 and 8 `tenantField` references, 0 predicates); disclosed because the new module is outside the gate's `SCAN_FILES`.
- **Subclasses.** `TursoDriver` and `SqliteWasmDriver` override none of the four. The stubs keep their signatures, and every member the bodies call is a late-bound closure on the instance.
- **Path readers, screened.** No script, test, doc or ADR names any of the four, or the five moved declarations, by a `sql-driver.ts#…` pointer or a `sql-driver.ts::…` key. Prose mentions (`formula`'s `matches-filter.ts`, `objectql`'s `having-filter.ts`, `runtime`'s `expected-read-refusal-noise.ts`, `spec`'s `filter-cross-field-comparison-class.ts`, `cross-field-conformance-cases.ts`) name the functions or `SqlDriver.applyCrossFieldComparison`, which are all still true. The one reader by path that depends on where they live is `sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts`, migrated below. The five cli `generate-*.pin.test.ts` files read `sql-driver.ts` text inside `createColumn`, `fieldHasColumn` and the width constants, all unchanged; four of them ran green at head (62 tests), the fifth is in the cli integration tier, which CI runs.

## The path reader migrated in this PR

`sql-driver-compile-refusal-seam.test.ts` enumerates every function that builds an `INVALID_FILTER` error by parsing `sql-driver.ts`, and pins the set of `withheldFilterError` callers equal to its `DOORS` rows. Two of those callers, `uncompilableFieldReferenceError` and `uncompilableNowAnchorError`, moved. The enumeration now parses `sql-driver.ts` and `sql-driver-cross-field-comparison.ts` with the same visitor; its three docblock lines say so. Nothing else in the test changed, and the `DOORS` table is untouched.

- **Head:** 115 tests pass.
- **Control:** the unmigrated test, run against the moved source (a scratch copy, not committed), fails exactly `every builder that goes through the seam is driven by a row below`, with the two moved builders missing from the scanned set. So the migration is what keeps the gate from going silently empty.
- Each `DOORS` row still asserts its builder by the error's own stack (`at uncompilableFieldReferenceError`), which the move does not change.

## The shape (#23050 shape B, as cuts 1-12 apply it)

- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, byte-identical (none was `async`). Its body is now one host literal plus `NAME.call(host, ...)`, marked `[#25521 cut 13]`, and returns the moved function's own result.
- Fields go as GETTERS that read the driver at call time (`isMysql`, `isSqlite`). Methods go as closures that call the method on the driver at call time (`crossFieldOffsetExpr`, `declaredFieldsFor`, `filterColumnExpr`, `mapSortField`, `nowAnchorBaseExpr`, `remoteColumn`, `resolveTenantField`). So a subclass override, an instance spy, or a field replaced after construction is still the one the body reaches (probe below).
- `CrossFieldComparisonHost` lists exactly those nine members, each typed as the class member's indexed access. There is no cast, and no member becomes public.
- **Module imports.** `temporalStorageForm` (`@objectstack/core`), the moved spec import, `type Knex` (`knex`), and from `./sql-driver.js` the eight shared declarations plus `type SqlDriver`.
- **Comments.** The module header says what moved, what stayed and why. The `sql-driver.ts` import comment names cut 13 in 3 lines. The header cites no `ADR-NNNN Dn`.
- **How the move was made.** A script produced it from the source text; nothing was retyped. Each body line is re-indented two columns; no body line starts inside a template literal.

- **`check:tenant-chokepoint`'s D8 rule does not scan the new module.** The two arms read the tenant column only to refuse it as an operand, and hold 0 of the file's 4 tenant predicates (measured with the gate's own `nullArmsOf`). Each is still true: the method is still a member and the function is still in the package.
